description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Demonic Gifts.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cormela enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
